question: Under what condition should the teacher grant the teaching that brings long life?
premises: The recipient must be well examined
Examination should be constant and careful
inference: Only after thorough examination should one give this teaching that grants long life.
uncertainties: dadyāccirajīvitam is sandhi-fused; cirajīvitam may refer to the teaching or its fruit
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one should give to him that which grants long life.
